name: Turns head off-screen
text: She turns her head to look off-screen left.
desc: Directs the audience at something outside the frame; sets up the next cut.
verdict: RENDERED 2026-08-04, 3 seeds, watched at subject crop. Motion 0.443/0.750/0.583 - at or below the empty control, and the turn happens anyway 3/3. IT OVERSHOOTS: the card asks for the head and the model turns the whole body. Only 7701 holds a usable profile; 7702 and 7703 carry on into a full turn and the face is gone by f96. Face survives 1/3. Reproduces motion_probe's finding on a fourth seed set. If you want the face given up, use turn_away, which asks for it honestly. Band 0.406-0.744 (empty control 0.628); frame-scale ceiling 1.191.
